meta.name: add-linear
meta.description: Add Linear channel integration via Chat SDK. Issue comment threads as conversations.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将 Linear 工单评论转为聊天会话
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果团队用 Linear 管理任务并希望直接在聊天中跟进评论。
copy.tagline_en: Turn Linear issue comments into chat conversations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your team uses Linear for task management and wants to follow up comments in chat.

howto.what: 装上后，每当 Linear 上有新的 issue 评论时，Claude 会自动加入对话并回复，无需 @ 提及。每个 issue 的评论线程成为一个独立会话。
howto.when: 当有人在 Linear 的 issue 中发表评论时触发。所有已配置团队的 issue 评论都会自动交给 Claude 处理。

say.text: 在Linear issue中回复：'已收到，谢谢。'
say.note: Claude会自动将这句回复发布到对应issue的评论中。

say.text: 请回复一下NAN-456的评论，说我们正在处理。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude automatically joins and replies to every new comment on Linear issues without @-mention. Each issue thread becomes its own conversation.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a comment is posted on a Linear issue. All issue comments from the configured team are automatically handled by Claude.

say_en.text: Reply in the Linear issue: 'Received, thanks.'
say_en.note: Claude will post this reply to the issue comment thread.

say_en.text: Please reply to the comment on NAN-456, saying we're working on it.
say_en.note: This directs Claude to provide a specific reply.
